objects.name: How to fix a bug in a fix
objects.description: Some vendors express concern about potential scenarios in which they are unable to fix vulnerabilities that are causing immediate user harm, due to limitations in their patch delivery systems. Since Project Zero encounters a wide array of systems designed to protect users in the case of exceptional exploitation scenarios, both through vendor discussions and security reviews, we want to share what we’ve learned.
